title: Townsend Brown's UFO interaction at age 17
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Townsend Brown's UFO interaction at age 17, about c. 1922 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He had a UFO interaction that inspired the rest of his work at the age of 17.

Catalina Island and a little orb light
approached him, literally came up to
him.
tellings.difference: Places it on Catalina Island and describes a small orb of light coming right up to him.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the teenage Townsend Brown's formative UFO encounter, the one that inspired his later work.

as_told.title: Townsend Brown's orb encounter on Catalina

tellings.quote: he attributes a lot of his life's work to a UFO experience he had, I think, at the age of 17 on Catalina Island.
tellings.difference: The teller hedges ('I think') on the age and the place, and does not describe the orb approaching him.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe Townsend Brown's UFO or orb encounter at age 17 on Catalina Island, which inspired his life's work.
